facts.statement: The solo variant is played by a single player.
facts.sourceSentence: Playing the single-player variant is the same as playing the regular game, the only difference is that you are scoring against yourself.

facts.statement: The solo variant uses the same rules and procedures as the regular game.
facts.sourceSentence: Playing the single-player variant is the same as playing the regular game, the only difference is that you are scoring against yourself.

facts.statement: The only rules difference in the solo variant is that the player scores against their own prior results rather than against an opponent.
facts.sourceSentence: Playing the single-player variant is the same as playing the regular game, the only difference is that you are scoring against yourself.

facts.statement: The first solo objective is to beat your own total score for each match.
facts.sourceSentence: To start, just try to get a higher total score for each match.

facts.statement: After completing the higher-total-score objective, the next solo objective is to finish every game of a match with a final score that is a multiple of 7.
facts.sourceSentence: After you've conquered that, attempt to get a multiple of 7 as your final score in each game during the match.

facts.statement: The multiples of 7 relevant to that objective are listed as 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, and 49.
facts.sourceSentence: As a reminder multiples of 7 are 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, and 49.

facts.statement: A perfect solo match requires scoring one of each listed multiple of 7, in any order.
facts.sourceSentence: Therefore for a perfect solo match you would have to achieve a score of 1 of each in no particular order.

facts.statement: After completing the multiples-of-7 objective, the final solo objective is to achieve each of the 7 scoring hands across the games of a match, in any order.
facts.sourceSentence: And after you've conquered that, attempt to get one of each of the 7 scoring hands in each game during the match in no particular order.

facts.statement: A match is composed of multiple individual games, each with its own final score.
facts.sourceSentence: After you've conquered that, attempt to get a multiple of 7 as your final score in each game during the match.

facts.statement: The solo objectives form an ordered progression, each unlocked after conquering the previous one.
facts.sourceSentence: And after you've conquered that, attempt to get one of each of the 7 scoring hands in each game during the match in no particular order.
